name: Rahiolisaurus
sum: Late Cretaceous abelisaurid from the Lameta Formation of Gujarat, India, based on fossils of at least seven individuals.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Elements from at least seven different individuals.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
